goal: Add an optional script output index and RPC to query historical transactions by address, script, or descriptor
Allow external wallets and explorers to query history without maintaining separate heavy indexing servers
agreement: Strong support across multiple reviewers for adding built-in script indexing (kravens, ViniciusCestarii, arejula27)
Verified by testing layout, false positive rate, sync time, and reorg paging semantics (kravens, ViniciusCestarii)
Concept approval noting reduced overhead for low-resource nodes compared to Electrum servers (arejula27)
Earlier design and safety objections resolved; minor open interface suggestions remain (kravens, ViniciusCestarii, arejula27)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it delivers a long-requested script index feature repeatedly attempted since 2013
Provides a compact ~54 GB index usable on pruned nodes to serve external wallet queries

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fills a key RPC gap by querying transaction history by script or descriptor
Enables downstream wallet and explorer tools to fetch script history without wallet imports
